# Patch Attributes {#sec-patch-attributes}

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(here)

here("R", ".setup.R") |> source()
```

This manual is still under development and may be subject to change.

This warning will be removed once the manual is finalized.
:::

Each patch in the model has the following attributes:

- **`value`**: A number representing the value of the climate variable.
- **`value-12`**: A `list` containing the current value of the climate variable with the previous 11 values. These values are ordered chronologically, with the most recent value at the end of the list.
- **`value-12ma`**: A number representing the 12-month moving average of the climate variable (`mean value-12`).
- **`latitude`**: A `list` containing two numbers indicating the minimum and maximum latitude of the patch point.
- **`longitude`**: A `list` containing two numbers indicating the minimum and maximum longitude of the patch point.
